text:
Ella Chen: Heads up — org update for capacity/runtime knowledge sharing and a people update. Short version: temporary rotation between Samir and Maya (approx 6 months) + new hire joining Observability team.
Samir Rao: I'll start the handover this week. Planning to do a 2-day shadow with runtime night shift so Maya can see throttles/burst behavior live.
Maya Lin: Thanks Samir — i'll focus on autoscale lambda tuning and the burst-smoothing scripts. Can someone point me to the repo?
Samir Rao: Repo links: https://git.internal/redwood/autoscale and https://git.internal/redwood/burst-smoothing. I'll drop a small README in the next PR.
Rowan Park: Hi all — excited to join as Head of Observability. Start date: 2026-05-04. Background: SRE/observability at AuroraCloud, built signal-denoising pipeline and OTEL ingestion. Office: NYC hybrid.
Priya N.: Welcome Rowan! Quick Q: will observability own alert threshold policy or will that stay with eng-sre?
Tom Becker: Good question. Short answer: observability will centralize dashboards and alert routing; eng-sre retains runbook authority and final threshold sign-off during the rotation. We'll revisit after 6 months.
Ella Chen: Recruiting note: Samir's IC mentoring responsibilities will be covered by a contract Senior Capacity PM until we hire a full-time backfill. Recruiting will circulate interview slots next week.
Samir Rao: Handoff checklist i'll publish contains: 
```
- oncall schedule + escalation matrix
- current autoscale policies (yaml)
- known gaps & tech debt tickets
- quick run commands for debugging under load
```
Maya Lin: I'll add a runtime checklist item: "how to reproduce burst in staging" with step-by-step commands.
Rowan Park: Can you @mention any alerting noise sources? I want to prioritize noise reduction in week 1.
Samir Rao: @Rowan Park most noisy items: cpu-surge alerts during GC, and a noisy integration timeout alert (svc-x). I'll tag the alerts in the next doc.
Priya N.: jen-bot: please create equipment ticket for Rowan and cc facilities.
jen-bot: Equipment request submitted for Rowan Park. Approval ETA: 48h.
Tom Becker: Please keep documentation in the shared org wiki and file RFCs for any policy changes. If you adjust alert thresholds, notify paging policy owners and SRE.
Ella Chen: Thanks everyone. We'll hold a 30-min sync Wed 10am PT (calendar invite sent) to align shadow schedule and the initial 30/60/90 onboarding plan. :calendar:
